description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01172425
Sheriff’s File # 26002364
PLAINTIFF – Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB, as Owner Trustee of the Residential Credit Opportunities Trust X-C, vs:
DEFENDANTS- Russell Thomas; et al.;
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 25th day of January, 2027
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Matawan, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 22, Block 11 Tax Map of Borough of Matawan
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
8 Johnson Avenue Matawan, NJ 07747
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 421.36ft from the nearest cross street known as Railroad Plaza and Harrel Street
Approximate Dimensions: 56.54ft x 486.07ft x 50.50ft x 174.70ft x 83ft x 85.03ft x 22.54ft x 99.32ft x 205.9ft
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Deed Book 8006, at Page 1246
Approximate Upset Price is $369,140.51 for the Sheriff's Sale
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated November 4, 2026.
Subject to: 2026 3rd quarter taxes due 8/1/2026, $3,793.23 billed; $3,793.18 Open Plus Penalty; $0.05 Paid
2026 4th quarter taxes due 11/1/2026, $3,793.22 Open; Subject to Posting
2027 1st quarter taxes due 2/1/2027, $3,417.52 Open
2027 2nd quarter taxes due 5/1/2027, $3,417.51 Open
Water: Acct. 703917 0, 6/1/2026-8/31/2026, $395.21 Open Plus Penalty; $297.62 Open Plus Penalty; Owed in Arrears
Sewer: Acct. 703917 0, 6/1/2026-8/31/2026, $216.70 Open Plus Penalty; $216.70 Open Plus Penalty; Owed in arrears
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $362,506.33.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: November 18, 2026
Hill Wallack LLP
21 Roszel Road
P.O. Box 5226
Princeton, NJ 08543-5226
(609) 924-0808
